summary.en: The Sudanese army has secured Bakori and Sali and repelled attacks in the Blue Nile while advancing in West Kordofan. Pakistan has signed a 1.5 billion military deal to bolster Sudan’s security. The UN reports that Colombian mercenaries backed by the UAE are fighting in Sudan. A former interior minister from the al-Bashir regime has been arrested, and Ahmed Haroun appeared on a podcast, prompting legal commentary. The IOM says 2,500 people have fled villages in North Darfur, and 4,680 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren har sikret Bakori og Sali og avverget angrep i Blue Nile mens den avanserte i West Kordofan. Pakistan har signert en militæravtale på 1.5 milliarder for å styrke Sudans sikkerhet. FN rapporterer at colombianske leiesoldater støttet av De forente arabiske emirater kjemper i Sudan. En tidligere innenriksminister fra al-Bashir-regimet er arrestert, og Ahmed Haroun dukket opp i en podkast, noe som har ført til juridisk kommentar. IOM sier at 2 500 personer har flyktet fra landsbyer i Nord-Darfur, og 4 680 dødsfall knyttet til kamper har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
